one_month_reasoning: Two scheduled events fall in the window to 2026-11-12: Texas Instruments' Q3 2026 report on Wed 2026-10-21 (call 3:30pm CT; PR Newswire), the main analog/industrial read-across, and ST's own Q3 2026 results with the Q4 guide on 2026-10-29 before the European open (ST release). Q3 was guided to $3.70B +/-350bp at 37.0% GM and Q4 'above $4B' (Q2 6-K), so the swing factors are the Q4 number and gross margin against a street that sits slightly above (FY26 consensus $14.43B implies ~$4.1B Q4), plus 2027 datacenter wording. No company filing has appeared since the 2026-10-13 6-Ks (EDGAR feed). I have no edge on the sign: the 40% de-rating from the June high lowers the bar, but ST guided below consensus in July and the stock fell hard that week. Volatility: 61% annual realized implies ~17.6%/month on average, but this month holds an ST earnings day plus a TXN read-across, so I use a fat-tailed mix (70% at 17% sd, 30% at 30% sd; overall ~21.7%) with a small negative tilt (median ~0.8% below spot), giving P(>=49.57)=0.48. Round 1 omitted TXN; adding it widened the tails slightly (upper tail 0.145 -> 0.17).

fair_value.method: Blend of 17.5x NTM GAAP (after-SBC) EPS at the horizon (~$3.02, from revenue ~$16.8B FY27 / ~$18.3B FY28 and GAAP EBIT margin 15% -> 19%, 900M shares, net cash $1,701M) = $52.86 (weight 0.7) and a DCF at 10.65% WACC, 3% terminal growth = $44.18 (weight 0.3); standard model engine base horizon value $50.26.

bear.story: 2027 recovery stalls (auto/industrial digestion, weak personal electronics, slower Apple content - 17.7% of revenue), SiC losses persist, gross margin stuck in the high-30s; market prices a 2028-29 down-cycle at ~14x lower EPS (-5pt growth, -4.5pt margin, -3.5 turns, +0.5pt WACC). base.story: Q4-26 >$4B, 2027 revenue ~$16.8B with datacenter well above $2B, GAAP EBIT margin 15% -> 19% in 2028 as unused-capacity charges fade and reshaping savings arrive; 17.5x NTM EPS ~$3.0 plus DCF.

bull.story: 2021-22-style analog upcycle, datacenter and LEO beat, CMD 22-24% margin reached in 2028; 21.5x. Roughly back toward the June 2026 high ($81.42).

That is a fundamental miss vs the Q4 >$4B guide and the reaffirmed $18B 2028 target, not ordinary 61%-vol noise. Kept above the bear value ($27.9).

reverse_dcf_check: The engine reports that the 17.5x horizon P/E implies a 9.3% WACC on our cash flows (vs our 10.65%). Held at 10.65%, the DCF only matches the multiple leg (~$52.9) if the GAAP EBIT margin from FY29 is ~24% (engine runs: 22% -> DCF $48.3, 24% -> $52.4, 25% -> $54.4) instead of our 20%, with 3% terminal growth: the top of the CMD 2027-28 band and below the 2023 peak (26.7%, F5/F1). That is plausible only if reshaping savings land and SiC breaks even, so the probability-weighted long-dated risks (~-$8/share in total: SiC, China, Apple, datacenter, down-cycle) are why we hold the multiple at the basis-adjusted peer median rather than above it, keep FY29 margin at 20%, and give the lower DCF ($44) 30% weight.

sbc_treatment.note: GAAP EBIT/EPS after SBC (FY25 SBC $193M = 1.6% of revenue, F25/F3). ST's non-GAAP excludes only restructuring/impairment and NXP-MEMS PPA, not SBC (Q2 2026 reconciliation), so ST consensus EPS is after SBC; peers' adjusted EPS mostly excludes SBC, so the peer median (16.56x after the gate's Renesas fix; 16.84x before) is lifted ~5% to 17.4x (17.7x before) for basis. Share count roughly flat (-0.3%/yr): buybacks offset award vesting; 900M diluted excludes the Tranche B if-converted shares whose principal is in debt.

reasoning: Primary-document lane, round 2. Unchanged core: ST is in an analog/MCU upcycle (FY25 trough $11.8B revenue, 1.5% GAAP operating margin; Q3 guide $3.70B/37% GM, Q4 'above $4B', datacenter >$1B 2026 and well above $2B 2027, $18B 2028 target reaffirmed), offset by low GAAP margins, SiC losses, 17.7% Apple concentration and a history of slipping long-range targets. Supervisor findings I verified at source and adopted: (1) the Q2 6-K's adjusted NFP is $1,701M after $306M of capital-grant advances, and since my capex is net of grants I use it; (2) 928.0M diluted shares include ~16.6M if-converted Tranche B shares ($750M / $45.10, Q2 OFR, net-share settlement in Q3 2026) whose principal is also in debt, so I use ~900M (928.0 - 16.6 = 911 upper bound; 892.55M outstanding + ~7M award dilution); (3) a Blume-adjusted beta (1.32) brings WACC to 10.65%; (4) MPWR is a fabless outlier, and with DIOD (verified 15.56x) in its place the 10-IDM median is 16.84x, so the multiple falls from 19x to 17.5x (basis-adjusted median 17.7x); (5) TXN reports on Oct 21, inside the one-month window. I also trimmed FY27 GAAP EBIT margin to 15% (consensus EPS less ~$330M/yr restructuring/PPA on 900M shares gives ~14.6-15%) and FY29 to 20% (from 21%) with +5% growth, since a 2028-29 slowdown is ~30% likely, and moved the tax rate to 17% from FY27 (18.1% 2026 guide incl. Pillar Two; FY24 16.7%, F44/F48). Result: 17.5x x NTM EPS ~$3.02 = $52.86 (70%) and DCF $44.18 (30%) -> $50.26, ~1% above spot (round 1 $51.14: the lower multiple and net cash were partly offset by fewer shares and a lower WACC).
